_about: Approved fixes, applied by tools/clean_studies.py on every run. Key = post id. Reference labels, commentary typos, and scripture quoted from a modern version replaced with the KJV text.

6730.find: *The presence of the Lord has scattered them, He will not continue to regard them; They did not honor the priests, They did not favor the elders*.
6730.replace: *The anger of the LORD hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.*

6976.find: *And He ordered us to preach to the people, and solemnly to testify that this is the One who has been appointed by God as Judge of the living and the dead.*
6976.replace: *And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.*

6976.find: *For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each one may be recompensed for his deeds in the body, according to what he has done, whether good or bad.*
6976.replace: *For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ; that every one may receive the things done in his body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad.*

10369.find: *And who is like your people Israel, the one nation on earth whom God went to redeem to be his people, making himself a name and doing for them great and awesome things by driving out before your people, whom you redeemed for yourself from Egypt, a nation and its gods?*
10369.replace: *And what one nation in the earth is like thy people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for thy land, before thy people, which thou redeemedst to thee from Egypt, from the nations and their gods?*

11140.find: *And He is the radiance of His glory and the exact representation of His nature, and upholds all things by the word of His power. When He had made purification of sins, He sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high*.
11140.replace: *Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;*

12404.find: **Each one had four faces: the first face was that of a cherub, the second that of a man, the third that of a lion, and the fourth that of an eagle.**
12404.replace: *And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of a cherub, and the second face was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.*

16516.find: *John to the seven churches that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from Him who is and who was and who is to come, and from the seven Spirits who are before His throne*.
16516.replace: *John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;*

5194.find: *Yet to this day the LORD has not given you a mind to understand, eyes to see, or ears to hear.*
5194.replace: *Yet the LORD hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.*

5194.find: *And He replied, "Go and tell this people: 'Be ever hearing, but never understanding; be ever seeing, but never perceiving.'*
5194.replace: *And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.*

5194.find: *Hear this, O foolish and senseless people, who have eyes but do not see, who have ears but do not hear*
5194.replace: *Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:*

4761.find: *To be apart from the body is to be with the Lord.*
4761.replace: *To be absent from the body, and to be present with the Lord.*

8549.find: *Let us therefore fear, least, a promise being left us if entering into His rest, any of you come short of it.*
8549.replace: *Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.*

8698.find: *For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.*
8698.replace: *For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.*
